game_title: Flowchart Lab · Find the larger number
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the lava scout's power beats the shield shown by lava imps.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a and b. Display a when a is greater than b; otherwise display b. Test dataset 10: {'a': 15, 'b': 10}; {'a': -10, 'b': -12}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the smelter by solving code steps involving power that move the lava scout forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the smelter first, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Comparison Duel – Crater Lake Edge Race
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
